title: Q15
description:
“Sit at My right hand, till I make Your enemies Your footstool.”
Read: Psa 110 (whole psalm), Mat 22:41–46
a) In Psa 110:1: “Yahweh said to my Lord.” David hears Yahweh speak to someone David calls Lord. What does that psalm bring into Hebrews that no angel text could?
b) Psa 110 goes on to a priest “forever according to the order of Melchizedek” (v. 4). What is Hebrews already setting up by citing verse 1 here (see Heb 5:6; 7:17)?
